title: Highly recommended
text:
This restaurant has been open for 56 years, we were invited to golden weddings, and we have visited for at least 35 years.
It is highly recommended, has menu and menu for 32 euros, without drinks.
It has a terrace that gives a lot of play in summer and caters to the diners of cruise ships that visit the Spanish village.
Mediterranean cuisine, hearty portions (we took three lunch boxes...) has several very good rice dishes.
Medium noise pollution, napkins and cloth tablecloths, excellent service. Bathrooms on the same floor. They have a dining room on the first floor that is only open for event
